line: Jung's passages naming nine (Dorn's novenary foetus, a company of gods called nine, the changing line of the I Ching, the ninth Sefira), his seminar remarks on the numbers one to nine, and von Franz on nine.

sections.title: The novenary foetus, and the changing nine
sections.line: CW13 (pdf p175, in Paracelsus as a Spiritual Phenomenon, 1942): Jung's account of Dorn on the One as the novenary foetus; CW11 ¶979 and ¶996: lines of six or nine in the I Ching and their change into the opposite.

quotes.quote: and it is also the “novenary foetus” (foetus novenarius), i.e., it is as the number nine to the ogdoad, or as the quintessence to the quaternity.
When any of the lines of a given hexagram have the value of six or nine, it means that they are specially emphasized
Lines designated by a six or a nine have, according to the ancient conception, an inner tension so great as to cause them to change into their opposites

sections.title: Count and company
sections.line: CW5 ¶408: the Ennead of the Egyptian Tum; CW12 ¶84: a company described as nine often proves to be ten or more; CW14 ¶634: Jezoth, that is Yesod, the ninth and middle Sefira in the lowest triad.

quotes.quote: the supreme god or hegemon of the Ennead
Although a company is described as “nine,” it often proves to be not nine at all but ten, and sometimes even more
is the ninth and middle Sefira in the lowest triad of the Cabalistic tree

sections.title: Nine in the seminar
sections.line: Visions seminar (25 March 1931): all numbers from one to nine are mana; Dream Analysis seminar: the numbers between 1 and 9 have become sacred, and in Egypt eight and nine.

quotes.quote: all numbers from one to nine are mana and certain numbers besides
In the course of civilization all numbers between 1 and 9 have become sacred
But two and one are also sacred, and in Indian religion it is four, in Egypt eight and nine

sections.title: Von Franz on nine
sections.line: Number and Time: von Franz on German neun as related to new, on five at the centre of the first number series 1 to 9, on the Lo-shu model in nine fields, on nine in number symbolism as the number of the Holy Ghost, and on nine provinces.

quotes.quote: where five stands in the center of the first number series
we again come across the number nine, in addition to the familiar arrangement of the Lo-shu model in nine fields
In number symbolism nine stands for the number of the Holy Ghost
8 for the eight winds and 9 for the nine provinces
